The same pink tick marks show that JR and RK are equal, KS and SL are equal, and JT and TL are equal, so R, S, and T are respectively the midpoints of the corresponding sides. The blue line segments LR, JS, and KT are all drawn and intersect at point P, and P is on median KT. Reasoning: Because LR, JS, and KT are the three medians of the triangle, they intersect at centroid P. The centroid divides each median in the ratio from vertex to midpoint of 2:1, so on median KT, KP:PT = 2:1. Given PT = 2, therefore KP = 2 × 2 = 4.

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate/vector setup instead of naming the centroid theorem. From the diagram, T is the midpoint of JL and S is the midpoint of KL, and P lies at the intersection of medians KT and JS. Assign convenient coordinates, for example J = (0,0), L = (2,0), so T = (1,0), and let K = (a,b). Then S = ((a+2)/2, b/2). Parametrize P on KT and also on JS; solving the two line equations gives that P is two-thirds of the way from K to T. Therefore along segment KT, KP/PT = 2/1. Since the text gives PT = 2, conclude KP = 4.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是三角形 JKL，点 T 在边 JL 上，JL 两段旁有相同的双刻痕，表示 JT = TL，所以 T 是 JL 的中点。点 S 在边 KL 上，KS 和 SL 旁有相同的单刻痕，表示 KS = SL，所以 S 是 KL 的中点。线段 KT 与 JS 相交于点 P，题目给出 PT = 2，要求 KP。推理：按坐标法设 J = (0,0)，L = (2,0)，于是 T = (1,0)。设 K = (a,b)，则由于 S 是 KL 的中点，S = ((a+2)/2, b/2)。点 P 在 KT 上，可写为 P = K + u(T-K) = ((1-u)a+u, (1-u)b)，其中 u 表示从 K 到 T 的比例。点 P 也在 JS 上，可写为 P = vS = (v(a+2)/2, vb/2)。比较 y 坐标得 (1-u)b = vb/2，所以 v = 2(1-u)。比较 x 坐标得 (1-u)a + u = v(a+2)/2 = (1-u)(a+2)。化简得 u = 2(1-u)，所以 3u = 2，u = 2/3。因此 P 在 KT 上距离 K 为整段 KT 的 2/3，距离 T 为整段 KT 的 1/3，所以 KP:PT = 2:1。已知 PT = 2，因此 KP = 4。
